The '''Primtara sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It bordered a number of other sectors, those being the [[Druess sector/Legends|Druess sector]], [[Corweillian sector/Legends|Corweillian sector]], [[Hevvrol sector/Legends|Hevvrol sector]], [[Iskin sector/Legends|Iskin sector]] and the [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]].
